title: cotoneaster racemiflorus var. orbicularis
intro: Cotoneaster racemiflorus var. orbicularis, commonly known as Cotoneaster, is a flowering plant species within the family Rosaceae. This plant is traditionally used in traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including improving digestive functions, reducing inflammation, and regulating blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Cotoneaster are attributed to its ability to promote bowel movement, reduce fever, and alleviate cough. The bioactive constituents of Cotoneaster include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
